adversarial_framing_finding: General/Macro Press sweep surfaced multiple Saudi geopolitical/security stories (Red Sea pipeline, Houthi-Saudi fighting). Checked framing across Middle East Eye and Al Jazeera: Middle East Eye (Qatar-linked) amplified Houthi claims that Saudi Arabia launched over 50 strikes in 24 hours, casting the Kingdom as aggressor. Used as a Negative Articles item.
notes: Watchdog/NGO monitoring: all 9 organisations searched individually; only older (out-of-window) reports found, none in the 24h window. Themed negative searches (human rights, labour, sportswashing, PIF, academic freedom, Mecca commercialization, soft power, investment/Neom, Vision 2030/tourism) returned only out-of-window/background material; LIV Golf bankruptcy (Sep 8) and PIF Wall Street pitch (Sep 8) both pre-window. The only in-window Negative content is the Red Sea/southern-border security-and-oil cluster (9/13-9/14).
